Photo 2 shows the rear; there is a rear rack/guard and a visible tail light. The rear badge/label area is present but not fully readable beyond general styling.

claims.evidence: No photo evidence of ownership history or giveaway origin.

claims.claim: % okay buy and drive to any location with battery everything
claims.evidence: Photos show the motorcycle, but do not confirm it starts, runs, or that the battery and all systems work.

risks.risk: Engine/bike may not start or may have mechanical issues (seller says “okay buy and drive”, but photos can’t confirm running condition).
risks.proof: Short video of a cold start + 5–10 minutes idling and a slow ride around the compound, showing no unusual smoke and stable engine sound.
risks.if_unproven: Price as not proven to be road-ready (worst case: needs inspection/repairs).

risks.risk: Battery condition is unknown (seller mentions battery, but no battery test is shown).
risks.proof: Photo of the battery label + voltage reading from a multimeter (or a jump-start test video).
risks.if_unproven: Price as battery condition unknown (worst case: battery may need replacement).

risks.risk: Electricals may be faulty (headlight, indicators, horn, brake light).
risks.proof: Video showing: ignition on, headlight on, both indicators blinking, horn, and brake light when pressing the rear brake.
risks.if_unproven: Price as electricals not guaranteed (worst case: some lights may not work).

risks.risk: Tires/brakes/chain & sprocket wear unknown; safety risk affects price.
risks.proof: Close-up photos of tire tread + brake pads/shoes condition + chain slack measurement (or video of braking while stationary).
risks.if_unproven: Price as normal-wear but not confirmed safe (worst case: may need brake/chain service).

risks.risk: Accident/damage or frame misalignment not visible in these angles.
risks.proof: Straight-on photos of both wheels alignment + underbike/frame inspection photos (and a short ride video showing straight tracking).
risks.if_unproven: Price as no damage proof (worst case: possible hidden damage).

proof_requests: Send a short video of cold start and the bike running smoothly for several minutes.
Show a ride test video (slow ride + braking) around the area.
Provide battery proof: battery label photo and voltage reading (or jump-start test).
Show electrical proof: headlight, indicators, horn, and brake light working (video).
Provide close-ups of tires tread, chain/sprocket condition, and brake condition.
response.reason: The photos identify the motorcycle as an AX100 (photo 0), but the seller’s key promise (“buy and drive… battery everything”) is not verifiable remotely. To price it correctly in Oyo, running/starting, battery health, and basic electrical/brake safety must be proven.
